judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: é concatenado dentro de LIKE '%...%'. Uma aspa fecha o literal e o resto vira SQL; ex.: busca=' UNION SELECT 1,1,1,login,senha,1,1,1,NOW() FROM usuarios -- devolve login e hash md5 de todos os usuários
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:82-85 (seguranca) explains the quote break-out and a UNION that returns logins and md5 hashes. listarChamados now delegates to listarChamadosDoDono, which binds '%'.$busca.'%' to c.titulo LIKE ? in a mysqli prepared statement (delivered lib.php:112-115, 129-133, 141-145); signature, ORDER BY criado_em DESC, keys and string-typed values are preserved (lib.php:150). %/_ are deliberately left as wildcards (non-changes list); C3 follows the probe (corrigida=true).

planted.report_excerpt: $busca é ecoado cru duas vezes: no atributo value="..." do input (linha 79) e em 'Resultados para:' (linha 82). Com busca="><script>...</script> o HTML é quebrado e o script roda na origem do painel.
planted.rationale: F5 at index.php:79-82 names both output points and the attribute break-out. htmlspecialchars($busca) is applied at both (delivered index.php:87 and :90). There is no explicit ENT_QUOTES, but PHP 8.1+ defaults to ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE and the attribute is double-quoted (escaped under ENT_COMPAT as well), so the fix is complete. Route and parameter unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: Títulos são texto livre e vão para o CSV sem neutralização. Um título que começa com =, +, - ou @ (ex.: =HYPERLINK(...)) é interpretado como fórmula quando o gerente abre o arquivo no Excel ou LibreOffice.
planted.rationale: F13 at lib.php:138-144 (seguranca) states the real mechanism. Deliberately not fixed (also in the non-changes list), because prefixing an apostrophe would change the Titulo values the billing integration consumes: titulo is still written raw (delivered lib.php:222); probe corrigida=false. C3 none and therefore C5 none, with no penalty, as in the rulings (declining it for the CSV's consumers).

planted.report_excerpt: O login grava uid e papel na sessão que já existia, sem session_regenerate_id(). Um id de sessão plantado antes do login (fixação) passa a valer como sessão autenticada.
planted.rationale: F14 at index.php:15-24 (covers the planted :24) describes session fixation. session_regenerate_id(true) is called right after a successful autenticar and before the session is written (delivered index.php:26). The same finding also sets httponly and samesite=Lax cookie params (index.php:15): bundled, credited once to this row, the cookie part listed as an extra.

planted.report_excerpt: autenticar() grava e compara md5($senha) puro (schema.sql:7, CHAR(32)). md5 sem salt se inverte por tabela pré-computada. Nos dados de exemplo, ana e bruno têm o mesmo hash, e carla e diego também
planted.rationale: F7 at lib.php:15-17 explains the fast unsalted hash and the identical hashes in the seed. autenticar now loads the user by login, accepts a legacy md5 with hash_equals and re-hashes it with password_hash on that login, and otherwise uses password_verify (delivered lib.php:13-37). The re-hash (migrarHashSenha, lib.php:44-60) runs only when usuarios.senha holds 255 characters; the delivered schema.sql declares VARCHAR(255) and ships the ALTER for live bases (schema.sql:7, :29-31). That is the matrix's transparent migration, and the width gate only avoids the CHAR(32) truncation lockout (a deployment caveat in the rulings). Signature and the ['id','nome','papel'] return are kept, no password is invalidated, and the widened column is not COMP-009 (rulings).

planted.report_excerpt: DB_PASS tem fallback literal 'N3tX@2013!prod' e SMTP_API_KEY é uma constante literal. Os dois segredos ficam em qualquer cópia do código (repositório, backup, este pacote).
planted.rationale: F6 covers both secrets (config.php:12-15) and asks for rotation. Both are now read from the environment with an empty fallback and no literal (delivered config.php:13 and :16); the new code comment does not repeat the values. C3 full under rule 11. The constant names are unchanged; a mandatory env variable is a deployment requirement, not PEN-001.

planted.report_excerpt: A rota ?ver chama verChamado($db, (int)$_GET['ver']) e mostra o resultado sem comparar chamados.usuario_id com $_SESSION['uid'], embora $papel e $uid já estejam carregados. Os ids são sequenciais (101..105), então dá para enumerar todos.
planted.rationale: F2 at index.php:52-58 is the IDOR, with id enumeration. After loading, the dispatcher answers 'Chamado nao encontrado.' when the caller is not a technician and (int) usuario_id differs from the session uid (delivered index.php:60, with $dono from donoVisivel at index.php:44 and lib.php:159-162); technicians still see every ticket and verChamado(mysqli,int) is unchanged. No COMP comes from the visibility work: the SLA average stays global, the web listing and CSV are filtered only for clients while technicians and the sessionless listarChamados()/exportarCsv() keep every ticket (enforcement, rule 6), and the int cast avoids hiding a client's own ticket.

planted.report_excerpt: Se nenhum chamado tem minutos_resposta (base nova, ou após arquivar os respondidos), $qtd é 0 e $soma / $qtd lança DivisionByZeroError no PHP 8. Como index.php chama mediaResposta() em toda listagem, o erro é fatal antes de qualquer HTML
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:116 (bug). mediaResposta now reads SUM/COUNT over the same rows and returns 0.0 for the empty set (delivered lib.php:180-183); the non-empty value is the same int/int division as before (no AVG rounding), and the average still covers every ticket. Probe corrigida=true.

planted.report_excerpt: Se a query falha, retorna sem fclose() e deixa chamados.csv truncado só com o cabeçalho, porque o modo 'w' já truncou o export anterior.
planted.rationale: F11 ('Exportação falha em silêncio e vaza handle', lib.php:126-135, bug) states the planted mechanism: the early return on a failed query leaves $fp open, so it maps to this row (rulings A4, the case of a finding that does state the mechanism). Fixed structurally together with F8: the query now runs before any handle exists (delivered lib.php:208-213), the CSV goes to php://output, and the only handle is closed at the end (lib.php:217 and :228) with no early return in between, so no path leaves it open. A DB error now raises before fopen, as the legacy query() already did under PHP 8.1's default mysqli reporting, so this is not COMP-005.

planted.report_excerpt: listarChamados() e exportarCsv() (linha 137) chamam tecnicoNome() para cada linha, e cada chamada faz um SELECT. Com N chamados são N+1 idas ao banco
planted.rationale: F10 at lib.php:89 covers both loops (:89 and :137), credited once. A LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome, '-') in the listing and in the export (delivered lib.php:123-125 and 201-203) keeps '-' for a null or missing technician and keeps string types; tecnicoNome is kept. Probe corrigida=true.

planted.report_excerpt: Estrutura do index.php (roteamento, autenticação e HTML num arquivo só, sem template) e falta de paginação na listagem: Separar camadas ou paginar é reescrita ou mudança de contrato (estrutura HTML e rotas). A tarefa pede evolução, não reescrita.
planted.rationale: Named only in the list of deliberate non-changes, at the right file and with the smell (routing, authentication and HTML in one file, no template): rule 5 gives R1 and nothing else. The entry says why it was not changed, not why the mixing is a problem, so R2 none; there is no refactor (index.php still routes, authorizes at :44 and :60 and builds the HTML at :84-105), so R3 none and R4 none. F17 (arquitetura) sits at lib.php:78-102 and describes a different design gap (a data API that carries no user identity), so it is not this row. No confidence was declared for the entry.

Magic numbers are not mentioned anywhere. F12 (lib.php:32-34, within 10 lines of :28) diagnoses the 'Resolvido' fallback for unknown statuses, another defect, so it is not a report of this row (rulings A4). Status 1/2 and priority 3/30/4 remain literals (delivered lib.php:67-73 and 84-90).

planted.report_excerpt: A regra de SLA tem quatro níveis de aninhamento com else redundante após return, e fica difícil ver qual combinação gera qual rótulo
planted.rationale: F18 at lib.php:40-59 (qualidade) explains why the nesting hides which combination yields which label, and the regression risk. Rewritten with guard clauses (delivered lib.php:79-91): null minutes, then priority < 3, then minutes <= 30, then the priority-4 split. The truth table is identical to the legacy nesting for every input, and the labels the report finds doubtful were left as they were.

extra_findings: F3 - listing visibility: the listing (index.php:72-73) showed every client's tickets to any client; the delivery filters by usuario_id for non-technicians through listarChamadosDoDono, while listarChamados() stays unfiltered (enforcement of the manifest's visibility rule, not COMP)

F4 - CSV visibility: index.php?export=csv (index.php:44-47) handed the whole table to any session; clients now get only their own tickets with the same header and format, technicians and the sessionless exportarCsv() still get every ticket (enforcement, not COMP-003)

F8 - fixed-name export file: exportarCsv wrote every ticket to EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv under /var/www/painel/tmp, left it on disk, and concurrent exports shared the file (lib.php:125-150); now streamed to php://output (not COMP: the manifest only promises the CSV on the output)
F12 - formatarStatus labels any status other than 1/2 as 'Resolvido' (lib.php:32-34); contracted behaviour, deliberately kept, so no COMP
F14 (bundled part) - session cookie without HttpOnly/SameSite; httponly and samesite=Lax are set before session_start (index.php:15)
F15 - the login has no attempt limit or lockout (index.php:20-29); reported, not changed
F16 - array-shaped parameters (busca[], login[], senha[]) reach string-typed functions and raise a TypeError (index.php:22-72); now treated as an empty search or a failed login

F17 - authorization lives only in index.php because listarChamados/verChamado/exportarCsv carry no user identity (lib.php:78-102); partly addressed by the internal helpers donoVisivel, listarChamadosDoDono and exportarCsvDoDono (corrigido=false)

F19 - tecnicoNome concatenates an int-typed id into SQL (lib.php:69); the report says it is not exploitable today (a latent pattern, so an extra and not a false positive per the rulings); converted to a prepared statement. verChamado's int concatenation is likewise called not exploitable and kept (non-changes list)

Non-changes list - no CSRF token on the login form (SEC-005), no logout, the role kept in the session, no 'secure' cookie flag or CSP headers, no pagination of the listing: named as known risks, not changed
notes: Binding: achados.json's leb block (LEB-100-A, 1.1, 68088abd...c8625) matches TAREFA.md, the matrix file and mecanico.json; manifest.md, TAREFA.md and .leb-pacote.sha256 are byte-identical to the package; code/ changes config.php, index.php, lib.php and schema.sql, seed.sql is untouched, nothing was renamed or added. Consistency: RELATORIO.md and achados.json agree on all 19 findings (ids, titles, file, lines, category, severity, confidence, corrigido, and the mechanism, impact and fix texts) and on the 12 deliberate non-changes; the report's count of 15 fixed out of 19 matches the index. No inconsistency found. Mechanical: characterization 22/22 before and after, no regression; probes SEC-001, BUG-001 and PERF-001 fixed, SEC-008 not. EXPL: expl_rubric is all zeros on purpose, because EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge (step 5). Judgment calls and hesitations: (1) BUG-004: F11 states 'retorna sem fclose()' on the failed-query return, so C1/C2 full (not the 'describes another defect' case); C3 full because the restructured export opens its only handle after the query succeeded and closes it with no early return in between, so no error path with an open handle remains. (2) SEC-014: C3 full; legacy md5 is accepted and re-hashed on login, the re-hash is gated on a 255-character column that the delivered schema.sql declares (with the ALTER for live bases); the gate is a deployment caveat, not a partial fix. (3) ARCH-002: R1 only, from the non-changes entry (rule 5); R2 none because the entry justifies the non-change without explaining the harm; F17 is a different design gap at another file and is kept as an extra. (4) ARCH-009: F12 sits within 10 lines of lib.php:28 but diagnoses the 'Resolvido' fallback, so the row is not reported. (5) SEC-015: C3 full under rule 11; RELATORIO.md (not the code) repeats the production DB password in F6's text; the half precedent concerns a code comment, so it is not charged here. (6) SEC-013: F14 bundles fixation with cookie flags and is credited once, to SEC-013. (7) F4 (CSV visibility, index.php:44-47) is within 10 lines of SEC-017's :53 but is another route and another defect, so it is an extra; F2 is the SEC-017 hit. COMP: none charged. Client-only filtering of the listing, the detail and the web CSV, with technicians and the sessionless listarChamados()/exportarCsv() keeping every ticket, is enforcement; the SLA average stays global; mediaResposta returns the same float; '-' and the string types are preserved; the on-disk EXPORT_DIR file is no longer written (not COMP, not PEN); senha widened to VARCHAR(255) (not COMP-009); LIKE wildcards behave as before; the new helpers (migrarHashSenha, listarChamadosDoDono, donoVisivel, exportarCsvDoDono) leave every manifest signature intact; a DB error in the export now raises, as the legacy query() already did under PHP 8.1's default reporting (not COMP-005). PEN-001: 0, no new defect found in the new code: COALESCE keeps '-', no sanitizer touches the technician column, both CSV paths use fputcsv with the default delimiter, enclosure and escape, rotuloPrioridade's truth table is unchanged, and array parameters degrade to an empty search or a failed login; the env-only secrets and the ALTER are deployment requirements. PEN-003: 0 (task 1.0.0). No decoy (SEC-009, PERF-006) is mentioned and no finding claims a flaw that does not exist, so false_positives is empty. A minor report imprecision, not scored here: F11 says a DB error 'agora vira exceção mysqli ... em vez de resposta vazia', but under PHP 8.1+ default reporting the legacy query() already threw.

expl_justification.clareza: The report has three clear parts: a Resumo with the verification method and a numbered deploy checklist, 19 findings in one template (Onde / severidade / confiança / Mecanismo / Impacto / O que fiz or Por que não corrigi / Corrigido), and Decisões split into what was done and what was deliberately left alone, plus a table of changed files. The prose is direct. Small blemishes keep it from impeccable: code identifiers are formatted inconsistently, F12/F13/F15 are restated in 'O que deliberadamente NÃO mudei', and the summary says the four unfixed items were 'só reportados' although F17 was partly addressed with helpers.
expl_justification.precisao: The report is specific and deep. It gives original line numbers that agree across findings, a concrete UNION payload, DivisionByZeroError in PHP 8, the mysqlnd binary protocol returning a native int where query() returned '105', MySQL AVG() rounding to 4 decimal places, strict mode vs silent truncation of bcrypt into CHAR(32), and COALESCE reproducing tecnicoNome's '-'. A few imprecisions show in the text itself: F7's title claims a non-constant-time comparison that its mechanism never explains; F11 credits the new exception behaviour to the PHP 8.1+ default, which leaves unclear how the original query-failure path could return silently; and the summary's 'lia o banco inteiro' stretches F2-F4, which leak tickets, to the whole database.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has a Mecanismo that names the defect and how it fires: a quote closing the LIKE literal; no usuario_id vs $_SESSION['uid'] check although $papel and $uid are already loaded; $qtd = 0 with no guard, in a function called on every listing; mode 'w' truncating the previous export before the query; array parameters raising TypeError. Several are reproduced on the test database. F17 names the systemic cause behind F2-F4: the lib functions carry no user context, so every entry point must reimplement the rule. Causal chains are spelled out (F1 with F7, F5 with F14, F8 with F11).
expl_justification.priorizacao: The report lists the findings 'em ordem de prioridade de correção', strictly by severity (crítica down to baixa), with a confidence score on each. Contract risk and infrastructure cost drive the fix-or-defer decisions, and there is a two-step deploy checklist (secrets via environment plus rotation, then the ALTER). Effort is never an explicit axis, the order inside each severity tier is not explained, and the report does not argue why F2 is crítica while the bulk leaks F3/F4 are alta, so it stops short of severidade x esforço x risco.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Decisões compares concrete alternatives for nearly every non-trivial choice: 403 vs full export vs filtered CSV for clients; the visibility rule inside the public functions vs entry-point helpers, with the remaining risk logged as F17; prepared statements vs keeping return types (normalize the listing, leave verChamado concatenated); AVG() vs SUM/COUNT; conditional rehash vs a truncation lockout; the secure cookie flag vs unconfirmed HTTPS; escaping LIKE wildcards; a rate-limit table vs fail2ban/WAF. The only choice of note left unweighed is F9 returning 0.0 for the empty case.
